hard_rules: Physical Parquet row order is market order truth; assign _seq before filtering and never re-sort raw ticks.
side is a tick-direction proxy only and must never be relabelled as true aggressor/bid-ask delta/CVD/absorption.
Only MTX six-digit outright expiries enter strategy research; spreads/combos are excluded.
Contract selection for causal claims uses calendar front-month policy; completed-day volume rank is diagnostic only.
No 2024 threshold, feature, regime, node or management selection is permitted; 2024 is validation only.
No 2026 Fabio outcome may be inspected before the candidate is frozen and the final holdout is intentionally opened.
Synthetic fixtures validate software only and never count as market edge evidence.
Signal edge, learnability and tradability are separate claims and separate gates.

coverage_policy.rule: Friday-to-Monday (3 calendar days) may retain Previous Value; any longer observed day-session gap resets the Previous Value chain. Exchange-calendar completeness audit may impose stricter quarantines for shorter missing expected sessions.
coverage_policy.known_gap_action: Do not bridge. Current observed day may rebuild a fresh profile for the next observed day.
coverage_policy.production_requirement: A versioned exchange-calendar completeness artifact must be included in the run manifest before G4 promotion.

causal_volatility_reference.causality: At event time only completed bars/ticks plus prior trading days may be used.
causal_volatility_reference.selection: Compare candidate scales in 2025 Discovery only; freeze one primary representative scale and any pre-declared secondary scale before opening 2024 Validation.
causal_volatility_reference.winner_value_rule: Mean winner points / frozen representative volatility scale must be reported; the 10% guideline is descriptive until the scale is frozen at Discovery exit.

causal_regime_registry.causality: A label at t may use only observations <= t and previous historical data; end-of-day labels cannot backfill intraday events.
causal_regime_registry.freeze_rule: Definitions/thresholds selected only in 2025 Discovery and frozen before 2024 Validation.

hypothesis_registry_policy.production_rule: EXPLORATORY/POST_HOC findings cannot enter the production tree without a new pre-registered generation and untouched validation data.

multiple_testing.discovery_method: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR within each pre-registered family
multiple_testing.validation_rule: Only hypotheses frozen at Discovery exit may be evaluated as confirmatory on 2024; no validation-driven parameter search.

dependence_and_bootstrap.bootstrap_method: cluster bootstrap with replacement over trading days
dependence_and_bootstrap.same_day_policy: All events on a trading day remain in the same resampled cluster.
dependence_and_bootstrap.overlap_policy: Overlapping attempts/setups are retained for signal-structure research but are not treated as independent observations; portfolio execution later applies duplicate suppression/cooldown separately.

max_drawdown.rule: Reject production candidate if either threshold is exceeded. Do not tune these thresholds on 2024 or 2026.

concentration.rule: Shares use positive-period R in the denominator; negative periods remain visible and are never dropped.

fill_models.MARKET: Fill at the eligible physical tick after the frozen latency rule.
fill_models.LIMIT_TOUCH: Optimistic analytic upper bound only; first future trade at limit or better. Never the sole production evidence.
fill_models.LIMIT_PENETRATION: Conservative limit proxy; require at least 1 index point penetration through the limit before fill.
fill_models.TOUCH_NO_QUEUE: Research-only sensitivity model; explicitly labelled as no queue model.

execution_model.friction: Report gross and a frozen round-trip friction grid; production promotion requires positive edge under the pre-registered stress grid.

session_policy.night_session: Separate research generation; never pooled into DAY_SESSION_INTRADAY_ONLY evidence.
session_policy.overnight: DISABLED for production_v1; no position may cross the day-session close.
session_policy.forced_flat_rule: Execution research must include a deterministic session-end liquidation rule before G7 promotion; its exact cutoff is frozen at Discovery exit before 2024 Validation.

risk_policy_engine.cooldown: Exact seconds selected in 2025 Discovery and frozen before 2024 Validation.
risk_policy_engine.rule: Risk policy may reduce exposure but may not be used to hide a negative raw signal edge.

human_review_protocol.low_learnability_warning: Cohens kappa < 0.60 or hard-negative discrimination near chance triggers review of whether the node belongs in human training.

training_effectiveness.claim_rule: Mastery volume/accuracy alone cannot establish training effectiveness.

certification_leakage.rule: Certification cases must be unseen at the semantic and near-duplicate level, not merely have a different event_id.

live_validation.shadow: Generate live decisions without orders; compare live decisions to offline reconstruction from the exact captured feed.
live_validation.paper: Apply frozen latency/fill/risk/session policies to live feed without capital.
live_validation.promotion: No direct jump from historical/live parity to capital deployment.

drift_monitor.structural_drift_rule: Raise STRUCTURAL_DRIFT when a frozen node/feature distribution or pass-rate moves beyond its pre-registered historical control limits; do not silently retune live.

reproducibility.determinism_rule: Same raw bytes + same code/config/dependencies must reproduce the same event/node/outcome evidence hashes.

database_policy.migration: Versioned transactional migrations only; fail closed on unknown schema version.
database_policy.backup: Create timestamped backup/checksum before production migration.
database_policy.recovery: A restore dry-run must be demonstrated before G8 promotion.
database_policy.training_store: Human attempts/reviews are non-rebuildable and require backup.

performance_sla.rule: No SLA claim until measured on a recorded CPU/RAM/storage reference machine using real data.

production_freeze.rollback: Keep prior production manifest/artifacts addressable; rollback is a manifest/version switch, never an in-place silent mutation.
production_freeze.material_change_rule: Any material scanner/node/threshold/regime/execution/risk change creates a new generation and reopens required validation gates.
